exposure: interval between last and present pregnancies
intrauterine contraceptive device (IUCD) use in the last year
cohort: 50 women with previous cesarean sections seeking maternal and child health services in a hospital in Buraydah, Al-Qassim region, Saudi Arabia were recruited and evenly assigned to case and control groups.
finding: Parity, the interval between the last and present pregnancies, and IUCD use in the last year were statistically significant predictors of cesarean scar pregnancy, and combined methotrexate and aspiration were the most prevalent treatment options.
